Find the value of $\frac{3}{5}÷\frac{3}{4}$ given the model above.
question.worked_solution:
The denominators are $5$ and $4.$ We can make a common denominator of $5\times 4=20.$ 

We split the shape on the left of the division sign into $4$ parts vertically, and we split the shape on the right into $5$ parts horizontally:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14155061/assets/d456f6fe7acc94b5a9e8e366fb2faea3ec2683e731a5e4cdafcdcbf6ce685bd2.png)

So, our division problem now is

$$
\frac{12}{20}÷\frac{15}{20}.
$$

Since the denominators are equal, this is equivalent to

$$
12÷15=\frac{12}{15}.
$$

Therefore, we conclude that

$$
\frac{3}{5}÷\frac{3}{4}=\frac{12}{15}.
$$
